reference.question: When did Phil Mitchell first arrive in Walford?

required_facts.fact: Phil first arrives in Walford in February 1990.

allowed_alternatives: Equivalent factual wording; Phil may use first person.

evidence.text: Phil Mitchell first arrives in Walford in February 1990 to open an automobile repair shop, known as The Arches; he is joined by his younger brother Grant (Ross Kemp). Two years later, Phil goes into partnership at The Queen Victoria public house with Grant and his wife Sharon Watts (Letitia Dean) – up to the point where he moves in with them. Phil grows close to Sharon, who turns to him for comfort during Grant's violent outbursts. Sharon and Phil have sex but she stays with Grant, who is unaware of their betrayal. Sharon and Grant's reconciliation is brief, and amidst more rowing and physical violence, Grant is arrested and imprisoned. In his absence, Phil and Sharon continue their affair but when Grant is released, Sharon reconciles with him, leaving Phil heartbroken. On the rebound, Phil enters into a marriage of convenience with Nadia Borovac (Anna Barkan) - a Romanian refugee - enabling her to stay in Britain, with Nadia departing after the wedding.
